title: Map hex
description: The JSON stored in campaign_map_hexes.data: what the GM has recorded for one hex of a hex map. Only hexes the GM has changed have a row; a hex without one is hidden and empty. Players are only ever sent status, name and description, and only for hexes that aren't hidden (server/routes/maps.py).

status.description: hidden: players see nothing of it. scouted: seen from afar. visited: the party has been there. Players see the name and description of scouted and visited hexes.

name.description: A short name for the place, or empty.

description.description: A small description of the location, shown to players once the hex is scouted or visited.

notes.description: The GM's own notes. Never sent to players.

encounters.description: Pre-recorded encounters: what is here, every time.

randomEncounters.description: The hex's random encounter table. A roll picks one entry, each as likely as its weight.

encounterKind.description: What sort of encounter it is.

encounterCreature.description: Creatures in an encounter: a creature from an installed pack and how many of it.

resolved.description: The party has dealt with it.

randomEncounter.description: One entry of a random encounter table.

weight.description: How likely this entry is next to the others: an entry of weight 2 comes up twice as often as one of weight 1.
